main_text.l: mea dabo &c. Sic Pharaoni & Ægyptiis conti-
PHARISÆI. Religiosus stultus, improbus astu-
tus, fœmina Pharisæa, ac illisio Pharisæorum in
lapides perdunt mundum; Sotah. cap.3.4. Fœ-
minæ Pharisææ fuerunt virgines & viduæ, sub
velo sanctitatis omnem nequitiam exercentes,
ut videtur ex Gemara in locum & Gl.
Pharisæi sunt האוכלי חוליהן כטהרות Illi qui

l.i: comedunt communem victum suum in munditia.

main_text.l: Gloss. in Chagig.fol.18.2.
Pharisæorum septem sectæ sunt, secundùm
Hierosol. Beracot folio 13.2. Sotah. folio 20.3.
Bab. Sotah. folio 22.2. Aruch in פירוש 1. פרוש
שכמי Pharisæus Sichemita. Gloss. qui circuncisus
est, sed non in honorem Dei &c. 2. פרוש
נקיפי Pharisæus illidens, Gloss. qui ob insignem humi-
litatem ita incedit, ut nec pedes efferat, ita ut
illiderentur pollices pedum ad saxa. 3. פרוש
קואי Pharisæus sanguinem eliciens. Gloss. qui ita
se præltitit ac si obturatis esset oculis, ne aspi-
ceret fœminam, atque hinc in parietes caput
allisit. 4. Pharisæus מדוכיא Mortarii, qui in
tunica fluente incedens mortarii instar erat.
5. Pharisæus ארעה מה חובתי ואעשה qui dicit,
nofcam meum officium & illud faciam. 6. Phari-
sæus ירא timoris ficuti Iobus. 7. Pharisæus אהבה
Amoris ficut Abraham. Hic solus pharisæus est
amore dignus. Hieros. cit.
De Pharisæis egerunt Viri Doctissimi. Hot-
tingerus in suo Thesauro. Leusdenius in Philolo-
go. Cl. Buxt. in Lex.Talm. pag.1851. Cl. Ligifoo-
tus Ev.Matth. pag.51.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek-looking characters in the text are rendered as printed as far as legible; some Hebrew words in lines 1 and 2 of the Pharisaic list are uncertain. Marginal notes on the left and right are small and partly illegible due to scan damage; not transcribed.
